blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists can expect more relief at the pump, with another round of fuel price rollbacks of up to ₱5 per liter likely next week. Based on estimates from Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas, diesel could decrease by P4 to P5 per liter. READ: DOE, oil firms urged to fully implement fuel price rollback Gasoline may also drop by P3 to P4 per liter. The forecast is based on the first four days of trading at the Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS) and foreign exchange movements. MOPS is the basis for the pricing of refined petroleum products in Southeast Asia. […]... Keep on reading: Oil price cuts may extend next week
